STATE OF NORTH CAROLINA
DEPARTMENT OF ADMINISTRATION
GOVERNOR

W. L. TURNER

DIRECTOR
STATE PLANNING DIVISION RONALD F. SCOTT STATE PLANNING OFFICER
REPLY TO:
CLEARINGHOUSE AND INFORMATION CENTER 116 WEST JONES STREET RALEIGH, N. C. 27603 (919) 829-4375
April 6, 1972
Mr. Yates M. Barber, Jr., Acting Chief Office of Environmental Quality Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife U. S. Department of the Interior Washington, D. C., 20240
Dear Mr. Barber:
Re: Draft Environmental Statement,
Proposed Endangered
Species Conservation Act of 1972
This is to acknowledge receipt of one copy of the subject draft environmental statement transmitted by your letter of March 22, 1972.
We have duplicated additional copies and referred them to appropriate State agencies for review and comment. Following this review, we will send you a letter summarizing or transmitting any substantive comments we receive.
It would be very helpful if you could furnish us twelve (12) copies of any future environmental statements for State agency review.
Sincerely yours,
RANDOLPH HENDRICKS
0/ 00 0
Planning Coordinator
